summary: Phase 1 audit of src/provider/openai.rs (1-620, full read): 6 defect candidates (1 High, 4 Medium, 1 Low) plus verified-clean areas.

files.description: OpenAI chat-completions passthrough provider: compat shaping, strict-400 retry, tool-name mangling, SSE parser, delta mapping.

architecture: OpenAiCompat::forward sends shaped JSON to {base_url}/chat/completions, retries a 400 mentioning 'strict' once without strict tools. chat_stream/chat wrap it: RateLimited(2s fixed) on 429, mangle_tool_names before send / restore after, sse_events unfolds a raw byte buffer into StreamEvents (data-line accumulation, [DONE]/finish_reason as terminal markers), parse_chunk maps usage/reasoning/content/tool_calls/finish_reason.
report:
FINDINGS (each with path:line, excerpt, failure scenario)

[High] Mangled tool-name collision routes tool call to the wrong function — src/provider/openai.rs:314-345 (mangle/mangle_name) + 594-603 (stream unmangle). Evidence: mangle maps '.'→"__", other illegal chars→'_', legal chars kept; mangle_name does `map.insert(mangled.clone(), name.to_string())`. Scenario: tools `a.b` (MCP `server.tool`) and literal `a__b` both mangle to `a__b`; second HashMap insert overwrites the first, so responses calling the first tool are unmangled to the WRONG original name — client executes the wrong handler with model-chosen args. Same for `x/y`→`x_y` vs literal `x_y`. Fix: detect collisions when building the map (apply the `__<sha256[:8]>` suffix path to every non-conforming name, or error).

[Medium] tool_calls delta missing `index` collapses parallel calls into slot 0 — :584-592. Evidence: `let index = call["index"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0) as usize;`. Scenario: gateways (llama.cpp server, some vLLM/proxy builds) omit index and distinguish calls by `id`; all deltas get index 0 so ToolCallAccumulator interleaves every call's argument fragments into one corrupt arguments string. Fix: key by call id when index absent.

[Medium] Spec-legal multi-line SSE data breaks JSON parsing — :366-370, 462-465, 528-531. Evidence: `data_lines.push(data.trim()...)` then `let data = data_lines.join("\n")` → parse_chunk's serde_json::from_str. Scenario: SSE permits data spanning multiple `data:` lines (joined by LF); a compliant upstream yields two JSON values separated by a newline → Err("invalid SSE JSON") fails the whole stream. Fix: skip unparsable data instead of failing, or parse joined lines separately.

[Medium] Unbounded error-body buffering + fixed 2s RateLimited ignoring Retry-After — :210-220, 262-268. Evidence: `return Err(crate::provider::RateLimited(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2)).into());` and `let buf = crate::provider::collect_stream(up.stream).await?;` before the status check. Scenario: 500/502 with large/endless error stream is fully drained into one Vec<u8> (no cap) pinning memory; a provider demanding 30-60s backoff is re-hit after 2s (comment admits headers unavailable). Fix: cap error body (e.g. 64 KiB); thread Retry-After through UpstreamResponse.

[Medium] Per-line buf.drain(..=pos) makes SSE parsing O(n^2) — :424-445. Evidence: `let pos = buf.iter().position(|&b| b == b'\n')` ... `buf.drain(..=pos);`. Scenario: each line scans from offset 0 and memmoves the whole remaining buffer; large chunks with many small SSE lines (typical token streams) → quadratic memmove on the daemon hot path. Fix: scan offset across polls or memchr-based single-pass splitter.

[Low] Strict-retry error path fabricates content_type, drops headers — :167-176. Evidence: `content_type: "application/json".into(), stream: Box::pin(futures::stream::once(async move { Ok(Bytes::from(err)) }))`. Scenario: a 400 on a strict-tools request whose body lacks the substring "strict" (e.g. 'Unsupported parameter: tools[0]', non-English text) is rebuilt with hardcoded application/json regardless of the real content-type and loses all headers; content-type-dispatching consumers misclassify text/plain errors. Fix: read content-type from resp.headers() before resp.text() consumes it.

CLEAN AREAS
- UTF-8 chunk boundaries (~365-520): raw bytes buffered, decoded only at \n (0x0A never inside a multi-byte sequence); final partial line via from_utf8_lossy — correct.
- Truncated-stream detection (~508-518): EOF without [DONE]/finish_reason yields Err instead of a fake clean Done — prevents persisting partial output.
- Usage riding with content/finish collected without dropping the rest (~560-570).
- Base URL: trim_end_matches('/') in new() (~39) + paths starting with '/' — no double/missing slash.
- Shaping gated to exact POST /chat/completions; provider header chars validated at construction with context (~26-46).
- Multi-tool-call chunk queuing preserves order; queued Done sets done (~417-421).
- tool_choice and replayed message.tool_calls names mangled alongside tools (~68-100).

NOTES: cargo test not run (forbidden). ToolCallAccumulator (llm.rs), compat::apply, inband internals out of scope; findings cite only the openai.rs boundary contract.
